marketLayer.title: HK Big Tech & Enterprise Cloud
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index rose 1.8% driven by positive enterprise cloud revenue growth and expanded AI integration announcements from major Chinese internet firms.
marketLayer.inference: Monetization of enterprise AI software is beginning to translate into tangible revenue, boosting valuation multiples across Chinese technology blue chips.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential tightening of US export controls on advanced computing hardware and cross-border data transfer regulations.

marketLayer.title: US Semiconductor & AI Hardware
marketLayer.fact: US chipmaker futures gained momentum as supply chain reports confirmed strong demand visibility for high-bandwidth memory and advanced AI packaging through late 2026.
marketLayer.inference: Capital expenditure commitments from major US hyperscalers remain resilient, reinforcing fundamental support for the broader hardware ecosystem.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: High valuation multiples leave leading semiconductor stocks vulnerable to short-term pullbacks if supply chain bottlenecks delay delivery timelines.

marketLayer.title: HK Southbound Capital & High-Dividend Stocks
marketLayer.fact: Southbound Stock Connect recorded a multi-month high in net daily inflows, heavily targeting high-yield state-owned telecom and energy stocks alongside select consumer platforms.
marketLayer.inference: Mainland institutional capital continues to seek defensive yield strategies to offset low onshore interest rates, establishing a floor for the Hang Seng Index.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of domestic consumer sentiment recovery and continuous restructuring challenges in the real estate market.
